verdict.rationale: Mollie documents several credential types. Advanced access tokens "can be scoped to a specific mode or profile", and API keys now show permissions grouped by business area and API. The official MCP server's agent setup requires a scoped token: profile.read is mandatory and each tool is enabled by its own optional per-API scope. Test API keys are isolated from live data, giving a further least-privilege option for agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the scoping works, and explicit docs on picking custom permissions per key and on expiry/revocation.
